MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN DELTA
(PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 2ND DAY OF MAY 2019
Present
Zeeshan Ali Khan
Imran Ali Khan

Chief Executive / Director
Director

Zeeshan Ali Khan chaired the meeting (“Chairman”).
Agenda
ENTER INTO PARTNERSHIP [ZAMEEN ACE MALL (DHA APPROVED)]
The Board was informed that the Company desires to become a partner in Zameen Ace Mall
(DHA Approved), a partnership firm, having its registered office at 3rd Floor, 94-B/1, M.M. Alam
Road, Gulberg III, Lahore (“Partnership Firm”), as per the terms and conditions of the
amended partnership deed in the form appended hereto as Annexure A (“Amended
Partnership Deed”).
The Board unanimously nominated Zeeshan Ali Khan, Chief Executive of the Company, to
discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal for and on behalf of the Company.
Resolutions
After discussing the aforesaid matters in detail, the following resolutions were
passed/approved/adopted by the Board:
1. Resolved by the Board that the Company become a partner in the Partnership Firm,
subject to mutually agreed terms and conditions of the Amended Partnership Deed.
2. Resolved further by the Board that Zeeshan Ali Khan be and is hereby authorized and
empowered to negotiate, enter into, sign, finalize, execute, deliver, and complete the
aforementioned Amended Partnership Deed and ancillary documents, and do all such
acts, matters, deeds and things and to take all steps and give such directions as may be
required, necessary, expedient or desirable for giving effect to the said Amended
Partnership Deed on behalf of the Company, from time to time.

Zameen Delta (Pvt.) Ltd.
Pearl One, 94-B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
